summary: A docs Worker on a plain zone route that fetches its own URLs for related pages. On a route, without the global_fetch_strictly_public flag, those calls go to the origin and never run the Worker again.

must_not_flag.reason: The Worker is served by a route pattern, not a Custom Domain, and sets no global_fetch_strictly_public flag, so a same-zone fetch() goes to the zone's origin server and skips Workers: there is no recursion and no fan-out of invocations. workers.dev and preview URLs are off. What is left is one cached KV read per public request. On a Custom Domain the same code would recurse with fan-out; that belongs under "Gated by", not in the as-deployed rating.
